caption:
Comment BLUEPRINT and I'll send it over: the whole faceless model, written out.

You can vet an offer in under 60 seconds. Four checks, run before you ever record a video.

WHY THIS COMES FIRST

A great hook, a clean script, a well-timed post. All of it is wasted on an offer that was never worth promoting. Vetting takes minutes. A bad offer costs you months.

THE FOUR CHECKS

Commission rate. Recurring, not one-time. Cookie window. Payout minimum. Not a vibe check, four specific terms, every time.

WHY THESE FOUR, NOT JUST ONE

A high one-time commission looks better on paper than a smaller recurring one. Then month two arrives, and the one-time payout is already gone. Recurring beats high, every time it renews.

WHAT A GOOD OFFER ACTUALLY LOOKS LIKE

A commission rate worth the traffic. Paid on renewal, not just once. A cookie window long enough to matter. A payout minimum you'll actually hit. No offer needs a perfect score, but fail two or more, and that's your answer.

THE HONEST PART

I'm not going to tell you what you'll make. I don't know you, and I don't know how hard you'll work.

It could be zero. Vetting an offer doesn't make anyone click it. This is a filter, not a promise.

But it's the filter that decides whether the rest of the work has a chance.

Comment BLUEPRINT and I'll send it over.
